credit.credit-words: God in Heaven Hath a Treasure
WORDS: P. S.; tr. by Emma F. Bevan. MUSIC: “Gloaming”; Unknown. Public Domain.

The kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he... buyeth that field. Mt. 13:44 But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us. 2 Cor. 4:6-7
*mean: low in status, rank, or dignity; of little importance
